# Northeast Machine

> A full-service diesel engine machine shop in Tonawanda, NY specializing in precision engine component repair, rebuilding, and machining with advanced testing equipment.

Northeast Machine & Motor Supply, Inc. has been serving the diesel engine industry with expert machining services for engine blocks, crankshafts, cylinder heads, and related components. The shop is equipped with precision tools including Magnaflux testing, dynamometers, and Sunnen honing equipment to ensure quality engine rebuilds and repairs.

## Key Topics

- Engine rebuilding
- Crankshaft repair and machining
- Cylinder head machining
- Engine block boring and honing
- Diesel engines
- Dynamometer testing
- Magnaflux testing
- Connecting rod machining
- Camshaft repair
- Engine assembly
- Precision machining
- Dye penetrant testing
- Tonawanda, NY
- Motor supply

## Core Engine Services

- [Engine Rebuilding & Testing](https://www.northeastmachine.com/services/i1nvvmdh57/engines): Engine rebuilding and dynamometer testing services at Northeast Machine
- [Crankshaft Repair & Machining](https://www.northeastmachine.com/services/i1mikhau31/crankshafts): Crankshaft repair and machining services with Magnaflux testing
- [Cylinder Head Machining](https://www.northeastmachine.com/services/i1xm4ofp10/cylinder-heads): Cylinder head machining, valve jobs, and crack detection services
- [Engine Block Boring & Honing](https://www.northeastmachine.com/services/i1miiqhp30/blocks): Engine block boring, honing, and pressure testing services
- [Connecting Rod Machining](https://www.northeastmachine.com/services/i1mifap129/connecting-rods): Connecting rod machining and engine rebuild services
- [Camshaft Repair](https://www.northeastmachine.com/services/i1midm5i28/camshafts): Camshaft repair and race engine preparation services
- [Miscellaneous Engine Work](https://www.northeastmachine.com/services/i1nvpr7k45/misc-engine-work): Miscellaneous engine machining and assembly services
